dedupe_keys.name: database of geological properties for the eu porous reservoir gas storage sites

description: Katriona Edlmann and the University of Edinburgh HyDRA team publish geological attributes for 134 European porous-reservoir gas-storage sites. The December 2025 deposit includes an Excel database, shapefile components and supporting documentation. Attributes cover operators, locations, working-gas capacity, status, wells, lithology, depth, pressure, temperature, porosity, permeability and salinity. Some quantities are derived, and the authors explicitly report many unknown properties because source information is limited. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. The collection accompanies HyDRA Deliverable D4.1 and is intended as a baseline for hydrogen-storage site screening and laboratory design. It can supply boundary conditions for reactive-transport, geomechanical and storage-capacity simulations. Inclusion does not establish that a gas-storage site is approved or safe for hydrogen service. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this database. Spatial coordinates, field completeness and the supporting documents were not inspected beyond their public metadata.
